Instructions for Use
Device description: The Sable Cochlear Implant is a cochlear implant. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 28 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Safety Information
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Sable Cochlear Implant is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
- Static magnetic field of 1.5 Tesla and 3 Tesla only
- Maximum spatial gradient magnetic field of 25-T/m
- Maximum MR system reported, whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 0.4-W/kg
- Maximum active scan time of 15 minutes
- Device configuration: MRI SureScan mode
- Scan regions: Extremity scanning only (knee and below, elbow and below)
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Sable Cochlear Implant is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 2.4 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
